core_categories: Patient Monitoring Systems; Pulse Oximeters; Blood Pressure Monitors; SpO2 Sensors; ECG Patient Cables; Temperature Probes; NIBP Cuffs
specialty_focus: Shenzhen Medke Technology is a manufacturer specializing in non-invasive vital signs monitoring and portable health devices, including patient monitor accessories such as SpO2 sensors, ECG cables, and NIBP cuffs. It focuses on innovation in sensor technology and connectivity for remote patient monitoring, serving as an original brand manufacturer with a global distribution network.
